title: Entitlement decided on the device, no server validation, no restore
notes: Seven defects and the two reported symptoms both trace to the same root. (1) Entitlement is an AsyncStorage flag anyone can write — P0 revenue loss, trivially spoofed. (2) No server-side receipt validation at all; the purchase result is trusted. (3) Expiry computed as Date.now() + 30 days on the device, so changing the clock extends the subscription, and it does not reflect actual renewal. (4) No restore path — this is the reported 'lost premium after reinstalling', and it is also an Apple rejection. (5) finishTransaction is called before any backend has recorded the purchase, so a failure between them keeps the money and grants nothing. (6) No purchaseUpdatedListener at startup, so renewals and interrupted purchases are never seen. (7) Hardcoded $9.99 rather than product.localizedPrice — wrong in every other currency and a rejection cause. Tests whether the agent leads with the entitlement model rather than the visible reinstall bug.
